batting.name: ST Jayasuriya
batting.dismissal: lbw b RE van der Merwe

batting.name: SR Tendulkar
batting.dismissal: c MV Boucher b R Vinay Kumar

batting.name: JH Kallis
batting.dismissal: c DS Kulkarni b DJ Bravo

batting.name: V Kohli
batting.dismissal: c JP Duminy b C Nanda

batting.name: RV Uthappa
batting.dismissal: c SR Tendulkar b DS Kulkarni

batting.name: RE van der Merwe
batting.dismissal: st YV Takawale b Harbhajan Singh

batting.name: R Vinay Kumar
batting.dismissal: st YV Takawale b Harbhajan Singh

balls.text: into the blockhole to finish the innings, Rahane whips it wide of square leg, where Virat Kohli has plenty of ground to cover before cutting it off
slammed down the ground by Duminy, but the placement isn't great, goes straight to the man in the deep
this time Rahane punches the full ball it to cover for a single
great shot from Rahane, that was a low full toss, on off and middle, Rahane walked across his stumps and turns it past short fine leg for a boundary
an attempted swipe is edged down to fine leg for a single this time
full toss, wide outside off, Duminy adjust superbly to crash it past a diving point fielder at the boundary
that was full and wide, just a touch too wide
crunched to mid-on for a single which helps him retain the strike
makes up for the previous ball with a wonderful shot, this was fuller and a bit wide, Duminy came down a step, bent his knee and carved it past the covers for a four to bring up his half-century
back of a length, outside off, Duminy throws his bat at it, doesn't connect, dot balls at this stage are precious for Bangalore
into the blockhole, Rahane looks to shuffle across the stumps to get it towards fine leg, doesn't quite get hold of it, the ball dribbles towards square leg
a full toss outside off, Duminy fails to capitalise as his drive is stopped by extra cover
Vinay Kumar's first ball is pushed towards mid-on, where Kumble misfields to allow the  batsmen an extra run
length ball this time, Rahane gives himself room and slaps it over covers, gets the placement perfect and that's a  boundary
a quicker googly from Kumble, Rahane went for the cut but was beaten by the extra bounce
full and on the pads, clipped to long-on for a single by Duminy, who is closing in on yet another fifty
Rahane stays on the backfoot and dabs it to third man for a single that brings up his half-century
fullish delivery from Kumble, Rahane was a couple of paces down the pitch, he drives it wide of long-off for a couple
nicely flighted by Kumble, on legstump, pushed to square leg for a single
slower ball, 117kmph, Duminy doesn't pick it and so was early on his attempted mow over midwicket, only gets the ball to roll along the ground to the midwicket fielder
Vinay bowls it full on middle, Rahane manages to work it towards midwicket for a single
comes down the track and plays it down to long-off
another six for Duminy, he showing how many gears his game has, Vinay Kumar rolls the fingers over the seam, it comes slowl onto Duminy who swings it over backward square leg for another half a dozen
overpitched on middle stump, Rahane slaps it to deep midwicket, from where Kallis lobs in a throw
starts with a slower ball, cramps Duminy for room, he manages to dab it towards point for a single
van der Merwe keeps it full, this time it's flat and on legstump, Duminy gets it away to long-on for a single
Shot! Duminy is stepping up here,that was tossed up, Duminy dances down the track and lashed it flat over the bowler's head for a six
Rahane gives himself room to free his arms and slams it towards deep point
slightly shorter, turning into Duminy, who waits on the backfoot and clips it behind square
full again, on the offstump, pushed back to the bowler by Duminy
fired into legstump by van der Merwe, Rahane plays it inside out towards cover
similar length but it is closer to the stumps, this time Duminy gets it to the deep, sweeper comes round to do the fielding, and that's the fifty partnership
full and wide, Duminy tries to crunch that through the covers, bottom hand comes off the handle as he plays that shot, straight to cover
Mumbai needed a boundary, and Duminy delivers, it was short from Mithun, Duminy was onto it in a flash, swings it high over midwicket for a six, he moves on to 24 off 21
again Duminy is down the track, punches it down the ground, long-off has to run around to his left to cut that one off
overpitched on middle and leg, Rahane turns it to deep square leg, the boundaries aren't coming for Mumbai at this stage
Duminy was down the pitch to punch that short-of-length ball to Appanna at mid-off, batsmen hurry through for a single
again Rahane comes down the track, move towards leg at the same time, slaps it over covers but can't beat the fielder in the time, enough time for the batsmen to take two
full and on the pads, glanced fine by Duminy, short fine leg keeps the batsmen to a single
worked towards midwicket by Duminy
overpitched and outside off, Ross Taylor misfields the drive from Rahane at extra cover, allowing a single
Rahane sashays down the track, making room at the same time, and slices it over extra cover for a couple
on middle and leg, Duminy clips it to square leg for a single
good over from Mithun, only three off it, Duminy steps forward to a short-of-length ball and punches it to long-on
powered straight back by Rahane, Mithun does well to part stop it, he deflects it towards mid-on, and the batsmen take a single
overpitched on middle stump, Rahane hammers it down the ground, but straight to fielder at mid-on, no run for a good shot
a touch shorter from Mithun, Duminy opens the face and glides the ball towards third man for a single
much better start from Mithun, again it's on offstump, a good-looking drive from Duminy, but straight to mid-on
starts with a length ball outside off, dabbed towards point by Duminy
on the pads, Duminy tickle it fine, placement is good but timing isn't, short fine leg chases after it and keeps the batsmen to a single
tossed up on middle stump, Rahane gives himself room and carves that towards the sweeper on the boundary
turned wide of mid-on for a single
this time it's on middle and off, Duminy bends his knee and sweeps, van der Merwe does a good job at fine leg to cut it off
fuller ball, Duminy plays it in the same region
nicely flighted, outside off, driven to the bowler's left by Rahane
defended off the backfoot towards square leg, nine runs off that over, Mumbai need more of those
Duminy goes for the paddle-sweep, gets a top edge because of the extra bounce, it runs away very fine down the leg side
pushed wide of mid-on for a single
Shot! topspinner from Kumble, Rahane gets down on his knee and clubs it over midwicket
a bit of width for Duminy, who glides it towards point
tossed up by Kumble, Rahane tries a cheeky dab to third man, a huge appeal from Kumble for lbw, the umpire deems it aas a run so there's no question of  an lbw
strays onto the pads, Rahane works it behind square for a single to end another good over from van der Merwe
another dot ball, more defence from Rahane, this time to mid-on
tossed up, length ball homing in on middle stump, defended by Rahane to the bowler
clipped behind square leg this time, the batsmen scamper through a couple
full ball on middle and leg, nudged to square leg for a single
Rahane continues to get the singles, he defends it to the leg side of the pitch
googly from Kumble, Duminy waits on the backfoot and slaps it towards point for a couple of runs
an appeal for lbw from Kumble, but that was going down over the stumps
another single for Rahane, to the off side this time
flighted delivery from Kumble, pushed to cover for a single to get off the mark by Duminy
turned to square leg by Rahane this time for a single
Rahane isn't too worried by the loss of Jayasuriya, clubs the first ball of the over to the midwicket boundary

van der Merwe completes a great over with the big wicket of Jayasuriya, that pitched just outside off and Jayasuriya was looking to send it into the crowd behind midwicket, he misses and is hit on the pad, and the umpire rules it lbw, Jayasuriya is very disappointed, he thinks that might have struck him outside off
gives it some air again, Rahane backs away and dabs it toward cover for a single
around the wicket this time, flighted and Rahane defends back to the bowler
overpitched on offstump, punched to long-off by Jayasuriya for a single
another dot ball, this was pushed through, wide outside off, left alone by Jayasuriya
van der Merwe tosses up his first delivery, pushed back to the bowler
'Catch it' is the cry after Jayasuriya clubs a shortish delivery from Kumble towards midwicket, it lands between two fielders and the batsmen take a single
on the pads, turned towards midwicket for a single that brings up Mumbai's fifty
played off the backfoot to long-off, batsmen get back for a quick couple
defended back to the bowler off the backfoot
not too short from Kumble, but Rahane to to smash that to midwicket, beaten by the pace and the lack of bounce
quicker delivery on the pads, nudged to square leg for a single
length ball, just outside off, Jayasuriya was looking to play that to leg, gets a thick inside edge onto his pads, and the ball rolls towards midwicket
another short ball, Jayasuriya goes for the pull, was early into the shot and the pull hits him on the forearm and dribbles towards backward point
short ball outside off from Kallis, Jayasuriya wait on it and tried to just tap it over the keeper but couldn't make contact
fullish on middle and leg, tipped towards midwicket, and the batsmen sprint through for a single
this time Rahane can't cover for the outswing, gets a leading edge which lands safely in the point region, it's a quick outfield and the ball races away to the deep
starts with a full ball on off which move a bit away from Rahane, who plays it to mid-on
again on the pads, but it was length ball, Jayasuriya punches it to mid-on, too hard to have time to take a single
overpitched on legstump, that's not a good place to place to Jayasuriya, who clips it over the short fine leg for a boundary
short of a length, on offstump, Jayasuriya was looking to turn it t leg but only manages to tap it back towards the bowler
it's a touch wide outside off this time, nicely worked down to third man by Rahane, van der Merwe does well to keep the batsmen to a single
What a hit from Rahane, that was a bit short, Rahane gets onto the front foot, and absolutely clobbers it over midwicket for the first six of the day
on target this time, on a length on offstump, defended off the front foot by Rahane
and another one, that was short and at 133.3 kmph, looks like some nerves for the youngster
starts off with a very wide delivery outside off
mishit from Jayasuriya, no timing at all on that shot, the ball was on the pads, Jayasuriya tried to swipe it to midwicket, only manages to chip it over the infield
fuller on off, pushed towards mid-off by Jayasuriya

boundary, how did he manage that? that was back of a length, and fractionally outside off, nowhere close to enough room to cut, Jayasuriya goes for the cut anyway and gets enough power to get it away for a four to point
good ball from Vinay, bowling his first ball to the left-hander, angling across the batsman, just outside off, left alone by Jayasuriya
on the legstump, turned to fine leg for a single by Rahane, easy run that
Vinay Kumar gets the ball to jag away again, Rahane guides it towards point off the backfoot
chipped over mid-off by Jayasuriya, not particularly well-timed but has enough to clear the man in the ring, doesn't go all the way, batsmen have time to take two
fullish on offstump, tapped towards mid-on, both batsmen set off immediately for the run and so were able to complete the single easily

sloppy work from Bangalore, slightly slower from Kallis, Jayasuriya tips it towards backward point and sets off for a single, Kohli pounces on the ball and shies at the stumps, the throw is wide and there's no one backing up, four overthrows
lost his radar, way down the leg side for a wide
short of length, on middle and off, Jaaysuriya closes the face of the bat too early as he tries to play it to leg, the ball rolls towards covers
tests Jayasuriya with the short ball, the batsman saw it early and got out of the way early, deemed a wide for height
cramps Jayasuriya for room this time, the batsman slaps it to backward point but doesn't beat the fielder

Kallis feeds Jayasuriya with a short and wide ball, Jayasuriya isn't going to miss out on those, he clubs it through the covers for four, not too well timed, but the ball trickles over the rope anyway
reverts to an offstump line, Rahane drops the ball at his feet and thinks of a single, but Jayasuriya declines, only three runs off that over
overpitched on the legstump, easy pickings for Rahane, he nudges it behind square for a couple
fuller from Vinay, on middle and off, defended cautiously by Rahane
Vinay Kumar strays down the leg side, he'll have to re-bowl that

gone, another failure for Sachin Tendulkar, back of a length ball pitching just outside off, moves away after hitting the seam and induces an outside edge from the Little Master, simple catch for Boucher, and Bangalore are ecstatic
closer to the stumps, Tendulkar gets forward and defends it towards the off side
good start, Tendulkar was looking to leave that one, it was overpitched outside off, but it hits the bottom of the bat and goes through to slip
similar length, a touch outside off, pushed towards square leg, but no run, tidy start from Kallis
back of a length, in the offstump corridor, defended back to the bowler
Kallis wisely switches to a fuller length, that was just outside off, Jayasuriya plays-and-misses again
lovely shot, trademark Jayasuriya, it was a bit short and there was room for Jayasuriya to work with, he dispatches it over cover for a boundary to get off the mark
Kallis is on target again, on offstump and Jayasuriya defends it back down the pitch
much better from Kallis, length delivery angling across Jayasuriya who fishes for it outside off but is beaten
there's a touch of breeze but it takes the ball down the legside
another swat to long-on, Bravo fields this time, and that's victory for Mumbai
a one-bounce four for Boucher, it was very full on the pads, Bravo at long-on completely lost sight of it
Kumble was backing away, Malinga follows him with a yorker which the batsman can't get away
this time Boucher can only get it down to Bravo at long-on, just a single
a golf swing sends a length delivery from Malinga screaming over the straight boundary
Boucher slogs it to midwicket for a single, 30 needed off five balls
yorker down the leg side, called a wide
didn't have the luck this time, Kumble's heave meets with air
tests Kumble with a bouncer, the batsman goes for a hook, top edges it over the keeper for a streaky four
full on legstump, gets an inside edge onto his pads
Boucher goes for the big swipe, misses and the ball goes past the offstump to the keeper
bouncer this time, well outside off, Kumble cracks it to mid-off for a single
low full toss from Bravo, slogged to wide long-on for a single
Kumble tries to whip to square leg, but is hit on the pad outside leg
Boucher is looking to make room, Harbhajan follows him with a yorker, which the batsmen digs out towards mid-on
very full and on legstump, Boucher clubs it wide of long-on, plenty of screaming before the batsmen decided to come back for the second
Kumble drives to long-on for a single which brings Boucher back on strike

Gone, Vinay Kumar is stumped by a mile, he was charging down the track, Harbhajan bowled it short and wide, the batsman didn't get anywhere near the pitch of the ball, and his wild heave connects with air, Takawale has the easy job of whipping off the bails
punched down to long-on for a single
and ends with a clever slower ball, Vinay was through with his attempted pull before the ball came through
another yorker from Bravo, this time Boucher manages to get it away to long-on but only for a single
Bravo follows the Malinga example and keeps it full, Boucher muscles it down to long-off
this time it's a wide, way outside off
yorker outside leg stump, Boucher had backed away to get some room, but that one slipped between his legs
well bowled by Bravo, very full on offstump, Boucher's attempts a scythe, hits the ball with the bottom of the bat, Vinay scampers back for the second
slapped to point for a single by Vinay, who was desperate to get off the strike
length ball outside off, Vinay gets it away to third man for a single and retains the strike
a bit shorter this time, Vinay walks across his stumps and flicks to square leg where a misfield gives away an extra run
yet another yorker that Vinay Kumar can't do much with, he digs it out back to the bowler
Malinga keeps in his favourite area, Vinay shuffles across and taps it to midwicket, there's no single this time
fats yorker from Malinga, crunched down to long-on for a single
very wide outside off, Bangalore won't mind more of these free runs
Malinga  unsurprisingly starts with a full ball, played with soft hands towards mid-off, and Boucher gets back on strike
another off-drive, another couple, this time Boucher places it wide of long-off so the second is taken with more ease
length ball outside off, driven powerfully to outside off, it was a tight second, Vinay barely made his ground
Boucher bends his knee as he tries to slog to midwicket, gets a top edge which luckily for him lands between two fielders
whipped powerfully towards midwicket. straight to the fielder
short and wide this time, dabbed to backward point, where Duminy cuts its off, Vinay was wondering whether to go a single, goes finally and just about makes his ground
Kulkarni starts his final over with a low, wide full toss, driven firmly to long-off
square leg has more work to do, there's some confused calling from the batsmen, who aren't sure whether to go for the second, finally decide against it
Boucher opens himself up for the sweep, misses the ball but is hit on the pads outside legstump
turned to square leg for a single this time by Vinay Kumar
arm ball from Harbhajan, goes past the outside edge of the defending Vinay
flighted, overpitched on middle and leg, defended back to the bowler

great job by Takawale, van der Merwe is stumped down the leg side, another fullish delivery, van der Merwe tried to flick off the front foot and overbalanced, the bails were off before he got back, this game is in Mumbai's bag now
Harbhajn fires it flat down the legside, van der Merwe looks to sweep, hits his pad and runs away fine for a boundary
that's a six from Boucher, the swipe just about clears the rope at midwicket, Harbhajan Singh was fielding in the deep and was kept interested till the last moment
steps out and drives a fullish delivery down to long-on for a single
whipped to midwicket for a single
low full toss on the pads, Boucher was looking to play to midwicket, gets a leading edge which lands just wide of Tendulkar at short cover
tossed up by Nanda, Boucher gets an outside edge towards third man
another short ball from Nanda, cut towards cover by van der Merwe
a full ball outside off, van der Merwe slaps it past point for a single to get off the mark
beautiful, Malinga does what he does best, full and fast, Taylor was looking to play it to leg, misses the ball and it crashes into middle and off
flicks another yorker on middle and leg to square leg, asking-rate is now 10.2
digs in the bouncer, Boucher spots it early and hooks it to backward square leg, Boucher made sure he kept the ball down
length ball on offstump this time, driven to extra cover
loses his radar this time, goes way down the leg side
starts off with a trademark yorker, on middle and leg, dug out towards mid-on by Taylor
this time he pushes it down to long-off for an easy single
Bang! Bangalore need more of those, Ross Taylor gets down on his knee and clobbers it over midwicket for a big six, that's a shot he used pretty effectively last season
low full toss outside off, punched to long-on for a single
fuller, on offstump, defended back to the bowler off the front foot
pushed through quicker, and on the pads, nudged behind square leg
short ball again from Nanda, Boucher waits for it to turn and chops it to backward point, a tight single is taken
a dot ball to end the over, on middle stump, Taylor dabs it to the leg side

big blow for Bangalore, Dravid is run out, Taylor punched the ball to long-off and immediately called for two, Dravid was always struggling and when Malinga's fired in an accurate throw, Dravid was well short as Harbhajan whipped off the bails
swept powerfully from middle stump to deep backward square leg for another single
full and outside off, Taylor slaps it to point for a single, both batsmen content to get the ones and twos for now
nicely whipped off the backfoot to square leg for a single
big appeal for caught behind, Dravid goes for the reverse-sweep, doesn't get any bat on it and the ball balloons off his boot to the keeper
sensibly driven down to long-off for a single by Dravid
innovative from Dravid, that was a length ball from outside off, Dravid paddle-sweeps it very fine to collect a couple
punched down to long-on for a strolled single
again Taylor isn't comfortable against the turn, it was a shortish ball but Taylor was onto the front-foot, and gets an outside edge past slip
Nanda pushes this one through on the legstump, flicked to square leg for a single
a bit of turn for Nanda, short ball outside off, left alone by Dravid
fullish ball on middle and leg, Taylor pushes it to midwicket, no run though, and that ends a good over from Harbhajan
Taylor shuffles across the stump to work a ball from offstump to fine leg, doesn't beat the fielder in the ring
Dravid sweeps a full ball on offstump to fine leg
straighter ball, pitching on a length, Taylor comes down the pitch and plays it down to long-off
fired onto the legs, hits Dravid's pad and rolls towards square leg for a leg-bye
nicely flighted from Harbhajan, Dravid gets a big stride in and smothers the ball with his front-foot defence
starts with a wide down the leg side
Taylor pushes at an outside off delivery, gets an outside edge but he had taken the bottom hand off the bat as he poked at the ball, which dribbles towards short third man
fullish on middle and leg, Dravid manages to get it away towards cover for a single
Dravid starts with a fluent offdrive for a couple
Kohli throws it away, it was a half-tracker but there was some extra bounce, Kohli swipes it straight to short midwicket
a bit of air from Nanda, a bit short and outside off, chopped to backward point
starts with a ball on the pads, turned to square leg for a single
Kohli gets himself a boundary, but not too convincing, he tries another loft over the leg side, this time aiming at midwicket, timing is completely awry but he gets it over the infield and for a four
on middle and leg, pushed towards midwicket by Kohli
Kohli has a close shave, he attempts the same shot that accounted for Uthappa, Nanda jumped at mid-on but it was just too high for him
fullish on middle and leg, Kohli doesn't make the most of that one, just turned to square leg
on offstump, defended back to the bowler by Kohli
Kohli tries to swat a shortish ball on offstump, doesn't connect well with it, ball trickles towards midwicket
short and wide from Kulkarni, Taylor shoulders arms to that one which was not too far away from being called a wide
Uthappa doesn't survive this time, he attempted the same hoick over mid-on, again he mishits it and it ends up as a simple catch for Tendulkar at short midwicket
pushed towards mid-off off the backfoot, no run this time
that was a close call, Uthappa fetches a length ball from outside off and tries to slam it over mid-on, doesn't get full hold of it, and it flies agonisingly  close to Harbhajan at mid-on
similar length, on offstump this time, Uthappa gets on the backfoot and drops it towards cover
Kulkarni starts with a back of a length ball in the corridor, Uthappa plays-and-misses
wonderful shot from Kohli, stands tall and cracks it past cover, all the way along the ground, add four more to Bangalore's total

Bravo gets the breakthrough, and Kallis is gone, shortish ball and was very close to the offstump, Kallis went for an upper cut which flies straight to the fielder at third man, nice, low catch from Kulkarni
Kohli was a goner if that hit, he just tipped it towards point and started to run, there was a bit of hesitation after that, but Duminy doesn't hit at the non-striker's end, so Kohli's safe
fullish deliver outside off, Kohli gets forward and pushes it towards extra cover
going down the leg side, Bravo goes up in appeal for a caught behind, might have brushed Kohli's thigh pad as the umpire doesn't signal a wide
a bot of away movement for his right away, Kohli doesn't move his feet as he wafts at it outside off, he's beaten
Kallis was looking to walk down the track, the ball was a bit short so he didn;t get near the pitch, ultimately plays it back to the bowler
again that fielder is made to work, as Kohli slaps an offstump delivery to him
square-driven off the front foot to deep point by Kallis this time, Kulkarani has a fielder there, so it's only a single
lovely shot from Kallis, fractionally short from Kulkarni, Kallis swings it just in front of square leg for a boundary, not much effort behind that shot
on middle and leg this time, Kohli doesn't get bat on it, hits his pads and rolls away towards the gully region
nice stump-to-stump line from Kulkarni, Kohli opens the face and runs it towards backward point

flicked off his thigh for a boundary to square leg, nine runs off the over, not quite as dramatic as the last time Kallis and Malinga faced off when the Sri Lankan was taken for 17 in his first over, including two sixes
nice and accurate from Malinga, Kallis pushes that length ball towards cover
mishit from Kallis, he tried to loft that offstump delivery over the leg side, outside edged over cover
length ball on middle and off, pushed back down the pitch by Kallis
on the pads this time, dabbed to the left of the pitch, slight hesitation before the batsmen set off for a single
finally on target, back of a length on offstump, defended towards point by Kohli
Malinga goes to the other extreme, short and very wide outside off
Malinga starts off with a quick, full ball down the leg side, that's a wide
shortish ball from Kulkarni, dabbed down to third man for a single by Kohli, six off the over
lovely shot to get off the mark, a backfoot cover drive, it pretty square and nicely in the gap, no chance for any of the fielders
strays onto the pads, he gets away with it though, as Kohli turns it straight to square leg
length ball on offstump, Kohli pushes it watchfully towards mid-off, good start by Kulkarni
shorter this time, on offstump, Kallis jumps onto his backfoot and taps it toward backward point, the batsmen sprint through for a single
starts with a fullish ball, Kallis defends off the front foot towards mid-off
